title: Phase 2: Build Express backend for BCH-Action JSON API
description: Build Node.js 25.6.1 + Express 5.2.1 backend with GET /api/action/:id endpoint. Serve BCH-Action JSON Schema v1.1.0 with icon, title, description, and links.actions array. Generate bitcoincash: URIs with op_return=464c4f5701. Implement CORS and OpenGraph meta tags. Use Express 5.x error handling patterns.

title: Style UI with Tailwind CSS glassmorphic dark mode
description: Apply Tailwind CSS styling across frontend dashboard and action renderer. Implement glassmorphic design with translucent panels, blur effects, and gradient borders. Dark mode color scheme with high contrast for narrative traction. Ensure mobile-responsive layout. Focus on conversion-optimized UI design.
notes: Dependencies: bch-81t (renderer component must exist first)

title: Implement Express 5.2.1 API routes for action metadata
description: Create backend Express 5.2.1 server with GET /api/action/:id endpoint. Route should return BCH-Action JSON Schema v1.1.0. Generate valid bitcoincash: URIs with mandatory op_return=464c4f5701 parameter. Implement Express 5.x async error handling middleware. Configure CORS for all origins.
notes: Dependencies: bch-wxb (project structure must be set up first)

title: Build React action renderer component with CashScript SDK
description: Create React component to unfurl and render BCH-Action JSON Schema as beautiful UI cards. Integrate CashScript SDK v0.12.1 to build transactions. Ensure SDK adds OP_RETURN output with 464c4f5701 prefix. Broadcast transactions to Chipnet testnet. Handle wallet connection and transaction signing flow.
notes: Dependencies: bch-qzi, bch-wxb (proxy and project structure must exist first)

title: Phase 3: Create Next.js 16 frontend with proxy and action renderer
description: Create Next.js 16 app with Turbopack. Implement proxy.ts for action/ route interception. Use 'use cache' directive for 5-minute edge caching. Build React component to render BCH-Action JSON Schema cards. Integrate CashScript SDK v0.12.1 for transaction building and broadcasting to Chipnet. Style with Tailwind CSS glassmorphic dark mode.

title: Create TypeScript deployment script for Chipnet
description: Create deployment script using CashScript SDK v0.12.1 and ElectrumNetworkProvider. Script should deploy Blinch.cash to Chipnet testnet. Include proper HD wallet derivation and transaction signing. Output contract address and save deployment artifacts. Include verification steps to confirm contract deployment.
notes: Dependencies: bch-ya4 (Blinch.cash contract must exist first)

title: Implement Next.js 16 proxy.ts for action route interception
description: Create proxy.ts file in Next.js 16 app to intercept and rewrite action/ paths. Proxy should forward requests to backend API. Implement proper request/response transformation. Handle errors gracefully. Follow Next.js 16 proxy patterns with new routing system.
notes: Dependencies: bch-wxb (project structure must be set up first)

title: Phase 1: Create CashScript smart contract with OP_RETURN enforcement
description: Write a CashScript 0.12.1 covenant contract that enforces OP_RETURN prefix 464c4f5701. Must include Execute function for recipientPkh and Cancel function after 144 blocks. Use native introspection via tx.outputs[i].lockingBytecode. Create TypeScript deployment script for Chipnet.

title: Set up project folder structure and initialize repositories
description: Create proper folder structure for Blinch project: contracts/ for CashScript files, backend/ for Express API, frontend/ for Next.js app. Initialize git repository. Set up package.json files for each component. Configure TypeScript with appropriate versions matching requirements: Next.js 16, Node 25.6.1, CashScript 0.12.1.

title: Write Blinch.cash covenant contract with native introspection
description: Create contracts/Blinch.cash file implementing covenant that guards funds. Must enforce OP_RETURN prefix 464c4f5701 check using tx.outputs[i].lockingBytecode introspection. Implement function execute(recipientPkh) for fund release. Implement function cancel() for creator after 144 block timeout. Follow CashScript 0.12.1 syntax.
notes: Dependencies: bch-wxb (project structure must be set up first)
